name: CumulativeSumNode
label: Cumulative Sum
description: Adds a column with the running total of a numeric column. The running total restarts for each partition.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute the cumulative sum for.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The numeric column to sum cumulatively.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. The running total restarts per partition.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the cumulative sum column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_CumulativeSum'.
